title: Metamora Hot Air Balloon Festival
specs: Over 20 hot air balloons launch on Friday and Saturday nights
Family-friendly celebration with music, games, arts & crafts, fireworks
gap: No ticket price or admission fee stated
blurb: This family-friendly celebration draws thousands every August with local food, music, art, a parade, crafts, and activities. Over 20 hot air balloons launch on Friday and Saturday evenings, weather permitting, from 5-8 p.m. The festival concludes with a fireworks display on Saturday night.
extraNote: Weather conditions allowing, balloon launches between 5-8 p.m. on Friday and Saturday evenings · Balloon launch field a few hundred yards south of the Metamora Lions Hall · August
